title: 每月千亿顺差：人类历史从未发生，贸易伙伴会反制吗？
speaker: How Hong

segments.en: And also, if you look at the Chinese trade structure,
so every month, we are producing over 100 billion US dollars in trade surplus.
segments.zh: 每个月产生超过一千亿美元的贸易顺差。

segments.en: It has never happened before in human history.
segments.zh: 这在人类历史上从未发生过。

segments.en: So basically, China now is sucking in all the global trades.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，中国现在吸纳了全球的贸易。

segments.en: Yeah, and foreign currencies. But then at the same time, you know,
segments.zh: 是的，还有外币。但与此同时，

segments.en: it's exporting these manufacturing surpluses, you know, to the rest of the world.
segments.zh: 它把这些制造业盈余输出到世界其他地方。

segments.en: I don't think this situation is sustainable, any bounty invite retaliation from trade partners.
segments.zh: 我认为这种情况不可持续，任何红利都可能招致贸易伙伴的反制。
